SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Complete the ten-resource ansibleops Terraform provider as one coherent lifecycle/reconciliation system.
REQUIRED_END_STATE: native Linux side-effect-free Read/refresh and drift reconciliation
state publication only after successful mutation with failure-safe retry semantics
Terraform Core sole durable state authority

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.state_identity: create state, stable IDs, restart stability
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.update_transaction: in-place updates, failure state retention, retry convergence, copy digest and named text semantics
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.delete_transaction: failure retains management, symlink target preservation, sibling-safe line/block/cron and user-home policy
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.runner_safety: structured argv, spaces/metacharacters, nonzero, timeout/cancel, temp cleanup, no full command output state
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.normalization: modes, unordered vars/groups, account observations and cron defaults
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.ansible_backend: mutation occurs through Ansible while Read remains native

outputs.EDGE_BOUNDARY_COVERAGE: PASS: boundary cases include absence/wrong-kind, collisions, already-absent destroy, digest changes, wildcard/default equivalence, literal path/data handling and restart behavior.
outputs.NEGATIVE_FAILURE_COVERAGE: PASS: nonzero mutation, timeout/cancellation, failed update/delete state retention and scoped-deletion failures are represented.
outputs.ORGANIC_COUNT_JUSTIFICATION: 30 F2P cases arise from six connected shared defect clusters across ten differentiated managed-resource lifecycles; six P2P cases preserve already-correct package/provider behaviors and guard against destructive over-repair.
outputs.TEST_INDEPENDENCE: PASS: tests assert solver-visible lifecycle outcomes through Terraform/Linux/runner interfaces rather than copying reference-solution implementation logic.
outputs.SOLVER_LOGIC_REIMPLEMENTATION_RISK: LOW_TO_MODERATE: verifier exercises externally observable lifecycle/state behavior; private implementation coupling is limited to fixture instrumentation and process observation.
